intro: End long days your way with TuneIn Sink into plush seats, recline at the touch of a button, ease back stress, and charge your phone while you relax. Your comfort, your control, without ever leaving the couch.

features.title: Recline your way, every day
features.text: Motorized recline, headrest, and lumbar support adjust independently, letting you find your perfect angle while the chaise offers uninterrupted lounging.

features.title: Chaise for full-body relaxation
features.text: Whether you prefer to curl up with a book or nap, the chaise provides extended space to stretch out, delivering a lounge-like comfort at home.

features.title: Console with smart storage
features.text: Built-in console keeps remotes, chargers, and small essentials neatly stored, so your space stays clutter-free while you relax.

features.title: Charge without moving a muscle
features.text: Built-in USB-A and Type-C ports keep your devices powered, so you never interrupt your comfort just to hunt for a charging point.

features.title: Style that feels like home
features.text: A dual-tone blend of mushroom fabric and peanut leatherette adds sophistication, fitting modern interiors with ease.

features.title: Upholstery built to last
features.text: High-performance fabric resists wear and tear while staying soft to touch, making upkeep simple and comfort long-lasting.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Tunein Motorised 2-Seater Fabric Recliner With Console And Left Hand Chaise
